Description: Susceptible individuals become infected through contact with infected individuals or corpses.
Non-symptomatic infected individuals become infectious and symptomatic.
Infectious individuals recover from the disease.
Infectious individuals may die from the disease and become infectious deceased.
Infectious deceased bodies can infect susceptible individuals.
Recovered individuals can die at the background death rate.
